objective: Prove #P-hardness for class-3 interacting pair failures whose edges satisfy every clean-edge condition except the vertex-root condition (V3): show the vertex equations are conserved flows, that flows vanish off the diagonal when the deficit equations are injective, that the diagonal flow is bilinear in independent free data, so the Fourier dual of the gadget count is a non-negative spin system with a rank-two witness; count the census algebras decided and state what the flow conditions leave open.
status: Proved: when an edge fails only the vertex-root condition, its vertex equations are a conserved flow; if the flow vanishes off the diagonal (F0, F1) and is bilinear on it (F2), the Fourier dual is a non-negative spin system and the count is #P-hard (Theorem 6); decides 8 more census algebras, 113 stay open.
title: Conserved vertex flows: class-3 pair failures blocked only by vertex-root brackets
